axes_source: Read from data/brands/ramp.json: warmth from the hue and chroma of the primary #E84A4A and the canvas #FFFFFF; contrast from the ink #0E0E0E on that canvas, its depth and the chroma of #E84A4A; density from its 8px spacing base; geometry from its radii 4, 6, 8, 12px; formality from the chroma of its primary and ink; motion from its stated durations 180ms, 600ms, 400ms; type personality at 0.5 since neither face is in the engine's catalog.
